seo.title: M-350 Rutile Titanium Dioxide Pigment | TiO2 Malaysia
seo.description: Evaluate M-350 rutile titanium dioxide pigment for coatings, printing inks and plastics. Review TDS-based technical data and request a sample or quote.

hero.summaryLead: M-350 is a general-grade rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced by the chloride process.
hero.summaryBody: It is evaluated for decorative, industrial and automotive coatings, printing inks and plastics, with excellent hue and high gloss, good dispersibility, strong hiding power, and good weather and temperature resistance.

positioning.heading: Where M-350 Fits
positioning.lead: M-350 is a general-grade rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced by the chloride process.
positioning.body: The current TDS lists high-end decorative paint, industrial paint, automotive paint, ink and plastic as application directions. Buyers should review the complete technical data and validate final suitability in their own qualification system.
